definitions.explanation: A set phrase said before eating to express gratitude for the food. Literally means 'I humbly receive.'

examples.english: I humbly receive this food. (said before eating)

examples.japanese: ⟦おいしそう→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧！いただきます！
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧いただきます。
examples.english: I put my hands together and say 'itadakimasu.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「いただきます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めました→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My mother said 'itadakimasu' and started eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「いただきます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}います→言う：00515_iu⟧。⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦{言|い}います→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, we say 'itadakimasu' before meals. Everyone says it.

notes: いただきます is said before eating any meal, expressing gratitude to those who prepared the food, the farmers, and all living things that gave their life for the meal. It's a fundamental Japanese custom. Children are taught this phrase from a young age. The verb ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ is the humble form of ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive).
